changelog: Modular file structure: `src/lib` is split into domain modules (ai, guidance, fraud, data, geo, auth, notify, shared) instead of one flat folder, with imports pointing at the owning domain. The test script now globs recursively so the suite keeps running from nested folders. No behavior change. Previous release: offline accuracy benchmark: `npm run bench:guidance` scores the guidance stack against labelled screens and fails CI on a regression. Deterministic answers are now measured (100% precision, up from 73%, on 67% of questions answered without inference). One shared element reader fixes the flywheel's "[3] [BUTTON] X" format being misread as static text. Fixes wrong spotlights for 'Amit ko phone lagao' (keypad instead of the contact's call button), 'akshar bade karne hain' and balance questions, and now flags answers that name one button while pointing at another.
